name: Actor 05B — SERP + AI Visibility → Google Sheets SEO Dashboard

parameters.content:
## Actor 05B — SERP + AI Visibility → Google Sheets SEO Dashboard

### How it works

This workflow runs weekly on Sunday at 11pm to collect SERP and AI visibility data through an Apify actor. It starts the tracker, fetches the resulting dataset, formats the returned visibility metrics, and appends them to a Google Sheets SEO dashboard.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger timezone and confirm the Sunday 11pm run time is correct.
- Add the required Apify API token or HTTP authentication details to the Apify request nodes.
- Verify the Apify actor ID, request payload, and dataset result URL expressions match the intended SERP and AI visibility tracker.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheet, sheet, and append range for the SEO dashboard.

### Customization

Adjust the Apify actor inputs to track different keywords, competitors, locations, or AI visibility sources, and update the formatting code to match the columns in your dashboard.

## Scheduled weekly start

Triggers the workflow automatically every Sunday night, providing the scheduled entry point for the dashboard update.

## Run and fetch tracker

Starts the Apify SERP and AI visibility tracker, then retrieves the generated dataset results for downstream processing.

## Format and append dashboard

Transforms the fetched visibility results into dashboard-ready rows and appends them to the configured Google Sheets SEO dashboard.
